description: Pause goals for a number of months, or start them again, **several in one call**. A paused goal is skipped by the projection and gives its monthly amount back to what is left in Plan for those months; it is not deleted and keeps its history. `months` counts this month: 1 skips this month only. 0 starts the goal again. Plan's own bucket is left alone. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first.

commit.description: Default false. False previews; true writes.

goals.description: One entry per goal. Up to 60 in a call.

goal.description: The goal, by id or by name.

months.description: Months to pause, 1 to 12, counting this one; 0 to start it again.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

name: pause_goals
title: Pause goals
